title: High Bandwidth Memory: What It Is and Why It Matters
summary_en: High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) is a critical enabling technology for artificial intelligence. The authors of this paper synthesize analysis of the HBM ecosystem for researchers and policymakers.
title_cn: High Bandwidth Memory: What It Is and Why It Matters

title: Do Robots Lure Us to War? The Impact of the Robotic Revolution on the Propensity for Armed Conflict
summary_en: The author developed a framework to understand the decision space for the use of force in the presence of emerging technology and applied it to autonomous weapons systems.
title_cn: Do Robots Lure Us to War? The Impact of the Robotic Revolution on the Propensity for Armed Conflict

title: Private Industry Approaches to Network and Security Operations Centers: Best Practices for the Department of the Air Force
summary_en: The authors describe how private companies structure, organize, and staff network and security operations centers, highlighting practices that could be applied to the Department of the Air Force’s efforts to modernize command and control.
title_cn: Private Industry Approaches to Network and Security Operations Centers: Best Practices for the Department of the Air Force
